claim.text: Sixteen consecutive pretrained PixelUMM blocks pass small/full-J real encoded-image input gates using shared GPU scratch, authenticated BF16 weights and default-off F32 FFN graph operands.
claim.scope: Blocks0-15; static repeated official image encoded with actual upstream DCAE and PixelUMM noise/stem; small416stages and full32attention/output boundaries; no denoised sample or complete decoder.
claim.decay_trigger: Refresh after scoped source/checkpoint/fixture/toolchain/device/OS/backend/geometry/precision/ownership/lifetime/guard change or loss of external evidence.

source.downloaded_scope: Decoder layers0-15 plus169DCAE encoder tensors and4PixelUMM stem tensors; no layers16-35/global head.

runtime.precision: BF16 weights and handoffs; F32 normalization/RoPE/attention intermediates; gate/up/down operands cast to F32 graph tensors, with BF16 output casts; graph types do not certify backend physical accumulation precision
runtime.oracle: Pinned upstream semantics adapted to gathered PyTorch2.6 MPS attention; not compiled upstream CUDA Flex. Native measured path contains no PyTorch.

real_input_and_cache.finite_check_scope: Producer checks terminal serialization copies of latent/xt/x. Reference checks imported BF16 x payload on CPU before prefix execution. Native graph has no added wait/readback.
real_input_and_cache.provenance_boundary: Native validates authenticated provenance metadata and x hash; origin relies on pinned executed Python producer/consumer, not metadata fields alone.

memory.lifecycle: One terminal wait, zero early activation reads and zero named encode allocations for every native request; opaque MPS allocations are outside named counters.

verification.audit_aggregate_timing_scope: Mixed 2/4/8/16 depths and small/full grids; not a sixteen-block latency benchmark. Use native_runs full-grid timed medians.
verification.scope: Full streamed payload hashes/record extents, source/binary pins, actualargv/guard caps/deadlines/swap/floor and non-overlapping successful GPU work. See external index for all artifacts.
corrected_routes: Double-digit capture names require numeric-owner prefix length, not fixed seven-character slicing.
Numeric cache owner set compares sorted expected and actual strings, avoiding10-versus2 lexical ordering assumptions.
Producer/consumer distinguish raw tensor payload size from complete safetensors subset size.
Audit v2 rejected a valid multi-chunk record by rechecking its start on each chunk; fixed interval invariant and >4MiB self-test in v3.
Audit v3 assumed a scalar reference block_count; v4 validates actual schema and adds metadata-first checking.
Audit v4 expected worktree-relative build objects; v5 binds exact external build object pins and checks their presence/size before payload hashing.
verification.retained_nonfinal_attempts: External failed build/falsifier, earlier audit versions and startup-blocked references are preserved; none support the passing numerical claim.

pipeline_planning.scope: 24 frames at24fps,704x1280,first segment,camera/action/history off; estimates are not end-to-end measurements

conditional_upstream_cache.scope: Pinned seg_ar dense BF16 KV allocation at batch1, SP1, one first segment, text_len1280, without compressed KV or CPU offload.
conditional_upstream_cache.upstream_drops_cache_references_before_v: For this non-streaming, non-preserved request: hymm/pipeline/causal_ar.py:3400-3441,3531-3595; allocator backing release in native integration remains unqualified

projections_not_measurements.pixel36_model: 36/16 times each observed 16-block median; omits global stem/head, may change with retained-plan allocator and thermal/queue state
projections_not_measurements.first_second_component_subtotal_formula: 8*T_DiT54 + (36/16)*T_Pixel16; excludes Qwen, global stem/head, scheduler, output and loading; measurement epochs are not matched

adversary.scope: Bounded16prefix numerical/lifecycle/artifact/guard claims; planning arithmetic only under explicit M64 text and conditional SP1 cache assumptions. Whole-pipeline peak, latency and quality remain unqualified.
adversary.lineage: Root plus same-lineage native/reference/pipeline reviews; correlated, not independent replication.
adversary.strongest_counterexamples: Distinct actual noise/stem input with NaN-poisoned shared scratch; full ordered capture coverage including blocks10-15; exact old-depth ceilings; footprint versus named-buffer and partial-latency versus end-to-end distinction.
adversary.planning_corrections: Review exposed omitted upstream dense KV storage and M64/23-valid-token timing scope; both are now explicit, with configuration/source pins and unqualified native lifetime policy.

residual_risk: Static encoded image input is not a denoised diffusion output or moving-video quality sample.
Only blocks0-15 are qualified; remaining20blocks, global projections and full pipeline are unqualified.
Compiled CUDA Flex and full checkpoint hash are unqualified.
MPS graph types do not prove physical accumulation precision.
Memory polling cannot bound between-sample peaks; opaque allocations can grow with more retained plans.
Measured epochs drift; no A/A causal attribution, cold-load benchmark, or generated-video throughput result.
Proposed stage release/output ring need explicit lifecycle/alias contracts and fresh qualification.
DiT timing projection is limited to qualified M64/23-valid-token saved conditioning. Native connected cache allocation and physical release are unqualified.
next_falsifier: Admit wider decoder only after refreshing memory; test two-bank lifetimes/alias safety before claiming whole-pipeline residency. Qualify global stem/head and connected stage boundaries before end-to-end latency or video-quality claims.
rollback: Omit sixteen-block entry point and --ffn-f32; keep earlier probes and BF16 default. Production arithmetic/sync sources unchanged.
